prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original Theandril dark-fantasy strategic game sprite, settlement.town, static first-facing pose.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, alpha zero around the isolated sprite. Do NOT paint a checkerboard, white/black backdrop, landscape, scene, floor tile, drop-shadow oval or framing panel.
Faction visual grammar: Sable Steppe, an original mixed-human steppe camp confederation. Lean adult proportions; rust felt, muted ochre cloth, indigo accents and black lamellar leather/iron. Mobile angular cloth cuts, practical travel equipment, no lavish imperial ornaments. Heraldry is exactly three broad wind-notch cuts arranged as a compact original simple seal. Settlement architecture combines yurts, taut angular tension roofs and protective walls, not medieval European castles. No copied fantasy franchise costumes.
Subject: One compact established town cluster of SIX or SEVEN dwellings, a larger communal hall and a low protective enclosure with one gate. Medium tier, wider and more organized than a village. grouped ochre/rust yurts, angular tension-roof market hall, practical timber/adobe perimeter. Sable steppe architecture only. Dry warm-season roof surfaces: absolutely NO snow or ice. No people, trees, landscape or rectangular slab.
Style: serious weathered medieval pixel art designed for a 96x96 native sprite; intentional broad pixel clusters and restrained material ramps, selective dark local-color outlines, crisp hard edges, soft upper-left material lighting. Adult anatomy, modest head about one-seventh body height, NOT chibi/cartoon. Keep every role readable when reduced to its native size; no painterly texture soup, antialias blur, microtexture or bright confetti.
Composition: exactly ONE sprite, centered with at least 15% fully transparent margin on EVERY edge. Shallow elevated three-quarter strategic view. Whole silhouette fully inside canvas; nothing cropped. Compact clearly separated roof masses; structural silhouette over tiny detail.
Color family: muted material colors only; steel stays grey, flesh stays natural, cloth carries faction accents. No glow, text, labels, watermark, logo, decorative page, multiple poses, sprite sheet or grid. Return an actual transparent PNG.
note: One original built-in generated asset. Full alpha>=128 silhouette bounds retained; nearest fitting and palette normalization prepare an unreviewed candidate, not visual approval.
